title.zh: 异常诊断：先判断是光学还是材料问题
title.en: Diagnosis: distinguish optical from material problems

subtitle.zh: CD摆动 / 站立波 / 残留 / 水印
subtitle.en: CD swing / standing waves / residue / watermarks

body.zh: 相似CD与缺陷症状可能来自光学设计、膜厚均匀性、界面化学或去除工艺。四类候选根因：光学反射/干涉/窗口；膜厚涂布不均/波动；界面去除/漂洗/浸没；显影或BARC Open去除不足。
body.en: Similar CD/defect symptoms can come from optical design, thickness uniformity, interface chemistry or removal. Four candidate categories are optical reflection/interference/window, coating/thickness variation, interface removal/rinse/immersion, and incomplete development/BARC opening.

body.zh: 1. 侧壁周期波纹：周期与光波相关，厚胶/高反射结构常见，指向站立波/反射。2. CD随下层膜厚周期变化：峰谷关联干涉，指向光学窗口/下层厚度。3. 中心—边缘CD差：径向或环形，常关联涂布/烘烤/均匀性。4. 水印/圆斑：多见TARC去除/漂洗，可关联浸没界面或干燥。5. 底部残留：槽底PR/BARC未清除而侧壁正常，提示显影或Open不足。
body.en: 1. Periodic sidewall ripples: wave-related, common in thick/high-reflection stacks, suggesting standing waves/reflection. 2. Periodic CD versus underlayer thickness: interference peaks/valleys, suggesting optics/thickness. 3. Center-edge CD differences: radial/ring patterns linked to coat/bake/uniformity. 4. Watermarks/circular spots: often TARC removal/rinse, immersion or drying. 5. Bottom PR/BARC residue with otherwise normal walls: insufficient development/opening.

body.zh: 看分布：全片/边缘/局部及周期方向。做膜厚—CD关联：结合椭偏/反射率判断相关性和周期。看PR截面侧壁：找周期波纹、区分光学与材料主导。对照多层光学模型：仿真反射/干涉，与实测对比。检查显影后残留和BARC Open充分性。最后关联PR/BARC材料、涂布烘烤窗口、去除漂洗、设备状态和均匀性，综合验证根因。
body.en: Map whole-wafer/edge/local distribution and periodicity/direction. Correlate thickness/CD using ellipsometry/reflectance. Inspect PR sidewall cross-sections for periodic ripples and optical/material dominance. Compare multilayer reflection/interference simulations with measurements. Check development residue and opening completeness. Finally relate PR/BARC materials, coat/bake windows, rinse/removal, equipment state and uniformity to validate root cause.

body.zh: 优化膜厚/涂布/烘烤均匀性，准确评估n/k并匹配层次，减少烘烤溶剂残留，优化显影窗口与去除一致性，提升刻蚀均匀性、减少叠加偏差。椭偏/反射率给膜厚及n/k；CD-SEM/XSEM查CD、侧壁、残留缺陷；FEM光场仿真验证反射干涉；缺陷图确认类型分布和周期；模型/实测CD—膜厚对比验证根因合理性。
body.en: Optimize thickness/coating/bake uniformity, assess n/k and stack matching, reduce solvent residue, improve development/removal consistency and etch uniformity. Ellipsometry/reflectance gives thickness/n/k; CD-SEM/XSEM checks CD, walls, residue and defects; FEM optical fields test interference; defect maps establish spatial/periodic signatures; measured versus modeled CD–thickness trends test root-cause validity.

body.zh: 不要仅凭一张截面锁定根因。相似形貌可由光学、材料或工艺多因素引起，须结合分布、量测和模型。先用空间分布、周期性和工艺前后对比建立证据链，再综合光学常数、膜厚、条件及多界面干涉逐步定位。
body.en: Do not identify a root cause from one cross-section alone. Similar shapes can arise from optical, material or process factors. Build evidence from spatial distribution, periodicity and before/after process comparisons, then integrate optical constants, thickness, conditions and interference using measurements and models.
